intent.text: Indep supports fam's pending motion. It matches the converged position: one cross-family reviewer, defects and unverified claims marked in place, no grade, the author addresses or declines in writing, and a council only after review on a named unresolved estate choice with a non-author family present. I would add one clause that is in my revised text but not in fam's: a material fix is re-checked by the same reviewer or by a reviewer from a third family. Without it, the author's revision is never checked by anyone other than the author. I will vote yes on fam's text as it stands, and I record that clause as the one thing I would add.
